name: Wildfire map and building matches for two Los Angeles properties
description: Two reproducible Los Angeles address and building checks against California’s 2025 local-responsibility wildfire map. Includes alternate address points, building IDs, raw zone codes, map matches and query sources.
scope: Two public facilities selected to contrast building identity and mapped classes. The checks cover addresses, building outlines and public map layers. Property mitigation, losses and insurance terms require separate records.

sources.title: Countywide Address Management System address points
2025 Fire Hazard Severity Zones in Local Responsibility Areas as recommended by the State Fire Marshal
Very High Fire Hazard Severity Zones layer, Special Areas map service

method.stateMapEdition: 2025 State Fire Marshal recommendations for Local Responsibility Areas
steps: Match the facility’s published address to the CAMS address layer using the stored filter. Inspect all returned points.

Query the county Building Footprints layer with each point using esriSpatialRelIntersects. Match the full official address, review the footprint selected by the point, and retain the county building ID. The alternate Observatory point is outside the selected footprint.

Fetch the selected footprint using its county object ID and outSR=4326. Pass its Esri JSON polygon to the CAL FIRE responsibility area and 2025 LRA layers with inSR=4326. Query first with esriSpatialRelIntersects and then esriSpatialRelWithin. Each selected building was within the one intersecting feature in each layer.
Query the city Very High layer the same way as a secondary map check. This response does not establish an ordinance effective date.

For the two Observatory points, project both points and the selected footprint to NAD83 / UTM zone 11N and round the straight-line point separation and the alternate point’s shortest distance to the footprint to the nearest meter.

interpretation.nonWildland: An explicit category in the CAL FIRE layer. It is distinct from a no-result query and does not imply zero wildfire exposure.
unresolved: Legal local map effective date for a particular policy or decision date
Current footprint or building updates since the source imagery
interpretation.idScope: Object IDs identify features in the queried service when checked and may change when a layer is republished. The county building ID is recorded separately.
